The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Widespread interveinal chlorosis (yellowing between veins)
- Dark brown/purple irregular necrotic spots scattered throughout the yellow tissue
- Main veins remaining relatively green compared to interveinal tissue
- No pustules or powdery growth visible

The reference image for Sudden Death Syndrome (top-right panel) matches closely — the same interveinal chlorosis pattern with scattered necrotic lesions while the midvein and lateral veins remain green. This is the hallmark SDS foliar symptom pattern.
